description: Deterministic CPU-only utility. Repairs a bounded set of common JSON syntax mistakes, returns canonical JSON, and optionally validates a documented JSON Schema subset. Missing fields are reported, never invented. Price: 0.003 USD via x402. Calling this MCP tool returns the canonical REST/x402 checkout contract; it does not execute the product or charge the caller yet.

schema.description: Optional structural JSON Schema. JSON Doctor validates the documented supported keyword subset and reports unsupported keywords explicitly.

text.description: JSON or JSON-like text to parse, conservatively repair, and return.

name: json_doctor
title: JSON Doctor
